account.description: The payee's account in force it pays into, by its last four characters; absent when they have none.

amount.description: What it pays: the sum of its items, in SGD.

items.description: The payee's bills or claims it pays, as the batch lists them.

paid.description: Released: bank import matched the payment to its statement line.

payment_id.description: Released: the bill payment or reimbursement the release posted.

payments_frozen.description: A change of the payee's bank account waits for approval: the payment is held (PAYEE-12).

rejected.description: Released: the payment was voided, as when the bank rejected it; its bills or claims are open again.

remittance.description: A supplier's remittance advice: waiting for the bank's statement line, queued once matched, sent, failed when sending it gave up after its attempts (⚠: tell the supplier another way), or no_email when the supplier has no remittance address (⚠). Absent for a claimant.
